performance.verdict: Paid channels fully dark 28 days; only organic GBP and search sustain inbound.

findings.text: Meta and Google spend are $0 across all 28 days and all 45 series days — no paid leads generated; account is fully dark on paid channels.
⛔ Extension with Marwan unsigned past 2026-08-31 deadline; contract lapse gates the next 3-month term and all paid reactivation decisions.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since 2026-08-31; contact-rate bottleneck (flagged July) remains unresolved without these CRM tools.
GBP actions dropped -100% in the last 7 days (0 vs prior-7d baseline of ~136 total actions), and sc_clicks fell -31.6%; organic inbound has effectively stopped.
GHL shows 24 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments in 28 days; pipeline is not converting any organic inbound — intake process appears stalled.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing immediately — 0 actions for 7 straight days vs 136 prior-28d signals a tracking break or listing suspension.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell to 0 for the last 7 days against a 28-day baseline of 136 total actions (49 calls), indicating a listing suspension or tracking disconnection. Assign to SEO/Ops to verify listing status, reinstate if suspended, and confirm call-tracking pixel is firing. Success check: GBP actions resume at ≥5/day within 5 days. Re-check 2026-09-14.

suggestions.text: No paid budget moves possible until extension with Marwan is signed; watch contract status, re-check 2026-09-12.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta and Google have been at $0 spend for all 28 tracked days and all 45 series days — no paid reactivation can be approved while the engagement contract remains unsigned past its 2026-08-31 deadline. suggestions.text: Escalate Zoho Voice access and SMS automation blockers — both overdue since Aug 31; contact-rate bottleneck cannot close without them.
